expect.offline: Create List splits the caption model's text on a literal backslash-n (the code's '\\n'), not on line breaks; a reply without that sequence is one item, Validate list formatting sends it back to Generate Video Captions, and the loop repeats until a reply carries it (with recorded replies, as often as the recording did). PiAPI, ElevenLabs, Creatomate and the files are stand-ins: images, audio and video are a few bytes; the waits are shortened by config time compression; Set API Keys' empty keys and the Discord webhook are filled by the overlay. The second branch after Get Raw File is the template's own: Write video names its file from $json.originalFilename, which Get Raw File's item (a file response: binary only, json empty) does not carry (from n8n-nodes-base 2.47.7's HTTP Request file handling, not yet seen in a run), so n8n is expected to stop there after the Drive, sheet and Discord branch; Read Video from Google Drive stores the file in `datavideo` while the uploads send `data`. Routes for the transcription and upload-post are given in case the branch runs. Notify me on Discord ships without a credential (the export stripped it) and the bench attaches none for the Discord node type, so n8n is expected to stop there first, before Write video; the overlay's Discord webhook applies only to a referenced credential
